disposition_reason: Text reports that chromium, mercury, arsenic and lead were below their LODs in all 20 infant formula powder batches collected in 2022; these censored results are extracted.

study.design: National market survey of liquid milk and infant formula safety and quality indices
study.origin: not stated (products manufactured in China per introduction)
study.market: supermarkets in different regions of China; abstract says 21 provinces
study.method: ICP-MS after microwave digestion with nitric acid (GB 5009.268-2016)
study.lod_text: Cr 0.05 mg/kg; Hg 0.001 mg/kg; As 0.005 mg/kg; Pb 0.02 mg/kg
study.qa: Performance criteria per GB 2762-2017 stated; no CRM or recovery data reported

unresolved: Heavy metals were analysed only in the 20 infant formula batches; the 294 pasteurized and 92 UHT milk batches were not tested for metals.
The paper does not state whether the infant formula was cow-milk-based; 'infant formula milk powder' only.
Values quoted from other studies (fermented milk Hg 26 ug/kg; raw milk Pb, As, Cr 1.75, 0.31, 0.05 ug/L) are quotes and not extracted.
